startsSoon: Transcription starts in a few minutes.
noMic: No access to the microphone. Allow Persist Notes in your system's privacy settings.
noSysAudio: The system didn't share the computer audio: only the microphone will be recorded.
sysAudioFailed: Couldn't capture the computer audio ({error}). Recording the microphone only.
sysUnavailable: Computer audio unavailable: {error}. Recording the microphone only.
sysSilence: No sound from the computer yet. If audio is playing, macOS didn't grant the permission: see Settings → Recording.
lowHour: Less than 1 h of recording left this month. This recording continues normally until you stop it.
noHours: This month's recording hours are used up. This recording continues normally until you stop it; the next one will be blocked.
stopped: Recording stopped. Transcribing the rest and generating the summary…
discardConfirm: Discard this recording? The audio and the transcript will be deleted. If you wrote notes, the note keeps only them.
discardedKept: Recording discarded. Your notes were kept in the note.
micFallback: The microphone {name} isn’t connected. Recording with the system default.
micSwitchFailed: Couldn't use the microphone {name}. Recording continues with the previous one.
outSwitchFailed: Couldn't switch the sound output to {name}. Change it in the system sound settings.
outSystemOnly: System sound output. To change it, use the Windows sound settings.
prepNote: Check the language and microphone before recording.
prepNoteApp: {app}: check the language and microphone before recording.
